## Design note

The parcel van on every block: front-drive, tall and slab-sided, with a little petrol four geared short for stop-start rounds. It is slow everywhere and a crosswind on wheels above 120 km/h, leans hard and understeers safely, and its high-sprung empty rear goes light under hard braking. Smaller, lighter and much slower than the Drayman — a moving wall rather than a rival.

## How this car breaks

Unibody van: no frame rails under the cargo box, so it is softer than the Drayman in every direction. The short nose holds the transverse engine and radiator right behind a plastic bumper; frontals reach the cab early. The cargo box behind the bulkhead is thin sheet on light hoops — side and rear hits dent it deeply without touching the cab, and the tall flat sides tip it in a hard swerve or a hit at the wheels.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 2000s European high-roof panel vans (petrol)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 1380 | 0.85 | 1170 |
| pitch | 4505 | 0.95 | 4280 |
| yaw | 4259 | 0.97 | 4130 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.88·W·H = 3.89 m²; Cd = 0.40 → **CdA = 1.554 m²**. Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.12 / +0.10 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

2.0 L DOHC 16-valve I4, petrol, port injection, van calibration. Class-typical 2000s 2.0 L petrol van engine (~43 kW/L, 85 kW at 5500 rpm, ~180 N·m at 3500), tuned for low-end pull, per manufacturer spec-class data.

Peak **85 kW @ 5500 rpm**, **180 N·m @ 3500 rpm**. Idle 750 / redline 6000 / limiter 6200 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.14 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 22 N·m. Power-to-weight 46 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

5-speed manual with short load gearing, open front differential. Layout **FWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 250 N·m. Shift time 0.30 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.73 | 16.52 | 45 |
| 2 | 2.05 | 9.08 | 82 |
| 3 | 1.32 | 5.85 | 127 |
| 4 | 0.97 | 4.30 | 173 |
| 5 | 0.76 | 3.37 | 221 |

Final drive 4.43, reverse 3.55. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.329 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.27 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 530 kg | 1.40 Hz | 41000 N/m | 2520 N·s/m | 3780 N·s/m | 0.18 m |
| Rear | 339 kg | 1.70 Hz | 38700 N/m | 1960 N·s/m | 2940 N·s/m | 0.20 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 5.5°/g with 62% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.704 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 132753 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 53769 F / 50758 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **10900 F / 0 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 5.5°/g, front share 62%. Bump stops 250000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.5° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 3.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 300 mm disc, pistons per side 60 mm → A = 28.3 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 125 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·28.3 cm²·0.125 m = **2827 N·m**
- Rear: 254 mm leading/trailing drum, wheel cylinder 20.6 mm → A = 3.33 cm², drum radius 127 mm, brake factor 1.8 (includes lining μ): T = BF·p·A·r = **762 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 2533 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.12×), rear needs 447 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.70×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 499 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.603** → delivered 2830 N·m front / 500 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 760 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 17.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 12.0 m → outer-front path radius 5.89 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.14 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.658 rad (37.7°)** (outer 32.9°, inner 43.9° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.70). Rack speed 1.1 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/tumbril_20.json`)

286 nodes, 1882 beams, 8 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id tumbril_20 --profile suv --width 1.92 --length 4.9 --height 2.3 --wheelbase 3.2 --mass 405.9 --car-mass 1845.2 --clearance 0.17 --front-overhang 0.8 --strength 1.0` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 3).
- Era `2000s` passenger cell: 178 cabin/sill, 165 cross-member, 10 pillar, 22 roof rail → hss × 0.90 section.
- Steel hood: 105 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Cargo box: 51 Cabin nodes behind the seat partition (y < 0.08 m, just behind the front doors) relabelled FrameRear — the passenger cell is the cab only, so cargo-box hits are body damage, not cabin intrusion.
- Transverse engine: gearbox mounted on the left end of the engine block (gen-lattice places it in the tunnel at the firewall, as for FR).
